<div id="data352-lecture6-viewer">
  <div class="lecture-viewer-toolbar" role="group" aria-label="Lecture 6 display options">
    <button type="button" class="lecture-viewer-fullscreen" aria-controls="data352-lecture6-frame" aria-pressed="false">Fullscreen slides</button>
    <a class="lecture-viewer-open-link" href="/teaching/DATA352/course_documents/all_lectures/Lecture_6.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open in new tab</a>
  </div>
  <iframe id="data352-lecture6-frame" title="Lecture 6: Model Based Inference" src="/teaching/DATA352/course_documents/all_lectures/Lecture_6.html" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const viewer = document.getElementById("data352-lecture6-viewer");
  const button = viewer && viewer.querySelector(".lecture-viewer-fullscreen");
  const frame = document.getElementById("data352-lecture6-frame");
  if (!viewer || !button || !frame) return;

  let fallback = false;

  function updateButton() {
    const expanded = fallback || document.fullscreenElement === viewer;
    button.textContent = expanded ? "Exit fullscreen" : "Fullscreen slides";
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(expanded));
    button.setAttribute("aria-label", expanded ? "Exit fullscreen slides" : "Enter fullscreen slides");
  }

  function closeFallback() {
    fallback = false;
    viewer.classList.remove("lecture-viewer-fallback");
    document.body.classList.remove("lecture-viewer-no-scroll");
    updateButton();
  }

  function openFallback() {
    fallback = true;
    viewer.classList.add("lecture-viewer-fallback");
    document.body.classList.add("lecture-viewer-no-scroll");
    updateButton();
  }

  button.addEventListener("click", async function () {
    if (fallback) {
      closeFallback();
      return;
    }

    if (document.fullscreenElement === viewer) {
      try {
        await document.exitFullscreen();
      } catch (error) {
        // The browser controls exiting native fullscreen.
      }
      updateButton();
      return;
    }

    if (viewer.requestFullscreen) {
      try {
        await viewer.requestFullscreen();
        updateButton();
        return;
      } catch (error) {
        // Fall back when Fullscreen API access is unavailable or denied.
      }
    }
    openFallback();
  });

  document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", updateButton);

  function onEscape(event) {
    if (event.key === "Escape" && fallback) {
      event.preventDefault();
      closeFallback();
      button.focus();
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener("keydown", onEscape);
  frame.addEventListener("load", function () {
    try {
      // Keys inside the same-origin iframe do not bubble to its parent.
      frame.contentDocument.addEventListener("keydown", onEscape);
    } catch (error) {
      // Cross-origin frames can still use the visible exit button.
    }
  });

  updateButton();
})();
</script>
